notes.title: Mute Crimson DX is OUT and you get it for free (if you own +) !
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830430/Mute_Crimson_DX/
Mute Crimson DX is a super enhanced, extended take on Mute Crimson!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9581958/600ffdf10ff72f6e9737bced94baa0f6c5533266.png[/img]
[h3][i]As Mentioned Above :[/i]
[i][b]IF YOU ALREADY OWN MUTE CRIMSON+, YOU HAVE DX RIGHT NOW!![/b][/i][/h3]
It works the other way around, too. If you buy DX and don't own +, you get + for free!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9581958/600ffdf10ff72f6e9737bced94baa0f6c5533266.png[/img]
With that out of the way, here's a quick rundown of the new stuff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9581958/71a65af456ebec2ff26f325e50e8217c882f5ce5.png[/img]
[list][*][b] 2 new worlds (9 total)[/b], with a bunch of new enemies, platforming twists, and cool bosses!
[*] [b]Rewind Mode allows you to rewind during gameplay[/b], making a difficult, but fair game a challenge anyone can enjoy!
[*] [b]Completely redone cutscenes![/b]
[*] Enhanced and [b]extended rearrangements of the original music[/b], as well as a bunch of new tracks!
[*] New[b] multi-layer parallax backgrounds![/b]
[*] [b]Major touch-ups to most graphics, [/b]including enemies, bosses, and other game elements!
[*] [b]Tons of redone sound effects[/b] and audio balancing!
[*] [b][i]New secrets![/i][/b]
[*] [i]A new unlockable mini game..?[/i]
[*][b]...and more! [/b]We really put a lot into it!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9581958/600ffdf10ff72f6e9737bced94baa0f6c5533266.png[/img]

[b]Thank you for supporting Mute Crimson, we hope you enjoy DX!
And leave us a review, if you could! It'd make a world of difference![/b]

- Iced Lizard Games

notes.title: Patch v1.1.0.0 Now Live!
notes.notes:
This release adds a new feature! XInput support and rumble has been added to the Windows version of Mute Crimson+! Of course, if you do not like rumble there is a button in the controls menu to toggle it off.

This release also includes various small fixes and tweaks, including fixes aimed at solving some Mac users startup crashes.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/x0QzFyu.png[/img]
